title: Quantum-Classical Dual LSTM Optimization for Internet of Intelligent Vehicles
summary: Published in the IEEE Internet of Things Journal (IF: 8.7).
details: Our paper proposing a dual hybrid quantum-classical framework for the Internet of Intelligent Vehicles appeared in the IEEE Internet of Things Journal, vol. 13, no. 16. Traffic-sensor placement is solved with QAOA whose variational parameters are tuned by an LSTM, while a quantum LSTM predicts traffic flow from the deployed sensing infrastructure.

title: Technical Program Committee member, QNC Symposium at IEEE IWCMC 2026
summary: Quantum Networks and Computing Symposium, Shanghai, China, June 1–6, 2026.
details: Served on the Technical Program Committee of the Quantum Networks and Computing (QNC) Symposium at the IEEE International Wireless Communications & Mobile Computing (IWCMC) Conference, held in Shanghai, China, June 1–6, 2026.

title: Quantum Clock Synchronization Networks: A Survey
summary: Published in IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials (IF: 50.6).
details: Our survey on quantum clock synchronization networks appeared in IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials, vol. 28. It gives a unified treatment of entanglement-assisted, interference-based, time-of-arrival, ticking-qubit, slow-clock-transport, and quantum-enhanced two-way synchronization protocols, and examines loss, decoherence, dispersion, relativistic effects, and security threats relevant to scalable quantum-synchronized networks.

title: Appointed Research Professor at Kyung Hee University
summary: Institute for Communications and Quantum Nexus, Communications and Quantum Information Laboratory.
details: Started as a Research Professor at the Institute for Communications and Quantum Nexus and the Communications and Quantum Information Laboratory, Kyung Hee University.

title: Five Korean patent applications filed
summary: Rydberg-lattice quantum reservoir learning, noisy state preparation, microwave quantum networks, variational portfolio optimization, and quantum-enhanced image understanding.
details: Five Korea patent applications were filed in March 2026: quantum reservoir learning for reinforcement-learning-optimized pulse and Hamiltonian control of a Rydberg lattice (10-2026-0044766); target quantum state preparation in a noisy quantum system (10-2026-0044751); a microwave quantum network for distributed superconducting quantum computing (10-2026-0044710); noise-adaptive variational quantum portfolio optimization (10-2026-0040373); and quantum-enhanced image understanding with a transformer model (10-2026-0040361).

title: Korea patent granted: Quantum property learning method and system
details: The patent “Quantum property learning method and system thereof” (Korea Patent No. 10-2930730) was granted on February 20, 2026, building on our work on universal quantum witness machines for learning coherence, discord, and entanglement.

title: Two journal papers in Early Access
summary: IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials and IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering.
details: “Approximation Algorithms for Vehicle Routing Problems: A Survey” (IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials) and “Quantum Fusion Learning for 6G Networks with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks” (IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering) are available in Early Access.

title: Noise-Robust Distributed Quantum Sensing: A Variational Quantum Approach
summary: Presented at IEEE GLOBECOM 2025, Taipei, Taiwan.
details: Our paper on noise-robust distributed quantum sensing with variational quantum methods appeared in the Proceedings of the IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM), Taipei, Taiwan, December 2025.

title: Best Paper Award at the KICS Fall Conference 2025
summary: For “Analytical Design of an LC Double-Notch Purcell Filter for Superconducting Quantum Circuits”.
details: The paper “Analytical Design of an LC Double-Notch Purcell Filter for Superconducting Quantum Circuits” received the Best Paper Award at the Korea Information and Communication Society (KICS) Fall Conference, Gyeongju, Korea, November 2025.

title: Counterfactual quantum communication survey and the GenSC-6G testbed
summary: IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials and IEEE Communications Magazine.
details: “Counterfactual Quantum Communication: Information Exchange in Quantum Shadows” appeared in IEEE Communications Surveys & Tutorials, and “GenSC-6G: A Prototype Testbed for Integrated Generative AI, Quantum, and Semantic Communication” appeared in IEEE Communications Magazine.

title: Visiting Scholar and QC3 Distinguished Lecture at Memorial University, Canada
summary: Collaboration with Prof. Trung Q. Duong on quantum fusion intelligence.
details: Visited Memorial University, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, to collaborate with Prof. Trung Q. Duong on quantum fusion intelligence, and delivered the invited lecture “From NISQ Networks to Global Quantum Internet: Perspectives on Vision, Applications, and Hybrid Integration” in the Quantum Communications and Computing Center (QC3) Distinguished Lecture Series.

title: Series Editor, IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
summary: Quantum Series: Quantum Communications and Networking.
details: Serving as Series Editor for the IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications Quantum Series: Quantum Communications and Networking, from June 2025.

title: Quantum fusion intelligence for integrated satellite-ground remote sensing
details: Our article proposing an integrated satellite-ground remote-sensing architecture that combines quantum fusion intelligence with quantum anonymous communication appeared in IEEE Wireless Communications, vol. 32, no. 3.

title: Quantum property learning for NISQ networks: Universal quantum witness machines
summary: Published in IEEE Transactions on Communications (IF: 8.4).
details: Our paper introducing universal quantum witness machines for learning coherence, discord, and entanglement appeared in IEEE Transactions on Communications, vol. 73, no. 4.

title: Variational anonymous quantum sensing
summary: Published in the IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications (IF: 16.8).
details: Our paper on a variational quantum sensing framework, in which a genetic algorithm optimizes parameterized probe circuits and quantum anonymous broadcast protects sensing information, appeared in IEEE JSAC, vol. 42, no. 9.

title: Visiting Scholar and invited talk at Memorial University, Canada
summary: Collaboration with Prof. Octavia A. Dobre on quantum property learning.
details: Visited Memorial University, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, to collaborate with Prof. Octavia A. Dobre on quantum property learning, and gave the invited talk “From Quantum-Integrated Computing & Communication: Towards Quantum-Integrated Sensing, Computing & Communication”.

title: Appointed Brain Korea (BK21) Research Professor
details: Appointed Brain Korea (BK21) Research Professor at Kyung Hee University.

title: Invited keynote at INISCOM 2024, Da Nang, Vietnam
summary: “Quantum Horizons: Revolutionizing 6G Computing-Intensive Communication and Networking”.
details: Delivered the invited keynote “Quantum Horizons: Revolutionizing 6G Computing-Intensive Communication and Networking” at the International Conference on Industrial Networks and Intelligent Systems (INISCOM), Da Nang, Vietnam.

title: Completed Ph.D. at Kyung Hee University
summary: Dissertation: “Quantum Property Learning for Quantum Sensing Networks”.
details: Completed the Ph.D. in Electronics and Information Convergence Engineering at Kyung Hee University under the supervision of Professor Hyundong Shin, with the dissertation “Quantum Property Learning for Quantum Sensing Networks”.
